{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Emerald green silk-blend blouse with a relaxed collar and subtle sheen, cut in a fluid silhouette that drapes from the shoulders to the hips at mid-thigh length, color #50C878.
Charcoal grey wool-twill wide-leg trousers with a high waist and gentle pleats, falling straight to the ankle with a clean hemline, color #36454F.
Cream cashmere cardigan with a ribbed texture and open front, designed to layer comfortably over the blouse for transitional autumn warmth, color #F5F5DC.
Nude leather loafers with a low block heel and soft piping detail, offering quiet elegance suitable for theater seating without restricting movement, color #E6CBA8.
Gold vermeil drop earrings with intricate filigree work set to catch the stage lighting, paired with a matching slim bracelet to honor the accent focus on jewellery, color #FFD700.

This outfit balances the evening setting of a 7 PM play with the autumn season by offering a structured yet breathable ensemble that transitions well from arrival to the performance itself. The emerald blouse provides a vibrant focal point against the neutral trousers, while the cashmere cardigan ensures comfort without overwhelming the neat social dress code requested for this occasion. Finally, the choice of gold jewellery and nude footwear respects the specific wish to highlight accessories while maintaining a polished, refined appearance appropriate for a guest at the theatre."}
